rules.name: Warlord
rules.description:
• If your Warlord dies all friendly Units within 8” must make a Panic Test (unless they are Immune to Panic).
• Every friendly Unit 8” from the Warlord may use his LD for Psychology Tests.

rules.name: Air Aura
rules.description:
Range: Self or 10” and LOS
Level: 3 or 8
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: The Lotus Eater erects barriers of wind, so strong that projectile weapons become completely ineffective. 
Effect: Cast at yourself (Level 3) or at a friendly Unit (Level 8). The target of the Spell becomes Immune to non template Shooting Weapon Skills until the End Phase of the game turn, when the Spell ceases to work, unless you spend 1 CP to sustain it for a maximum of one more turn. You cannot cast another Air Aura if the first one under your control is still in play.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Wind Blast
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 6
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: The Lotus Eater is able to force a gust of wind upon her enemies, pushing them away.
Effect: Cast at an opposing model. The model can make a normal Spell saving roll. If the save is failed push it back 10”. Mark a straight line from the Spellcaster to the target model and move it straight backwards, following the line. You cannot push the model outside of the Game board. After the model has been moved, it must take a Dex test or will be Dazed. If the model hits an impassable Terrain Feature, or reaches the Board edge, while moving, it automatically becomes Dazed and cannot be pushed backwards any further. 
Additionally, if the Spell is cast successfully, you may spend 1 CP to change the Weather Card to: Windy.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Levitation
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 1
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: The Lotus Eater summons a gust of wind to carry her away.
Effect: Cast at yourself at any time. You can levitate vertically up to 8” and move horizontally a maximum of 1”. If you are using a Climb type of movement and cast this Spell, deduct 8” from the climbing movement. If you fly away from a Paired Fight you cannot receive a Free Slash. Remember though, you have to be able to land somewhere legally.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Power of the Wind
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 6
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 5
Description: The Lotus Eater summons a gust of wind, helping friendly units.
Effect: Cast at any friendly unit. The effect lasts until the end of the Game Turn. Place an appropriate token next to the unit. The unit increases their Close Combat Weapon range to a maximum of 1”. If their Close Combat Weapon range is already 1” or greater then this cannot increase it further.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Wind Storm
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 8
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 5
Description: The Lotus Eater is able to cast a gust of wind at her enemies, pushing them far, far away.
Effect: Cast at an opposing unit. Each model from the unit has to make a Dex test or become Dazed. 
Additionally, if the Spell is cast successfully, you can spend 1 CP to change the Weather Card to: Windy.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Wind Wall
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 4
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: The Lotus Eater erects a barrier of wind around her, forcing all enemies to keep their distance.
Effect: After the Spell is successfully cast, all models (friend or foe) that want to move within 2” of the Spellcaster must take a Dex + own St test. If the test is failed, the model cannot travel any further. The effect of the Spell lasts until the End Phase of the turn and Shooting Attacks against the spellcaster suffer a -4 to hit penalty.
For example: Firstborn Cavalry attempt to Charge a Spellcaster who has cast Wind Wall. When the Cavalry are 2” away, they must take a Dex + St test which is 10+1. If the player controlling the cavalry rolls 11 or less they may continue their charge. If the test is failed, the cavalry models cannot move any further.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Tempest
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 7
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: The Lotus Eater summons the forces of nature to throw the enemy into the midst of a tempest, forcing them to take cover.
Effect: Cast against an enemy Unit. The Unit is allowed to make a normal Spell Saving Roll. If the test is unsuccessful no model from the targeted Unit may take an action (either Basic or Advanced) until the End Phase of the turn. Additionally, if the Spell is cast successfully, you may spend 1 CP to change the Weather Card to either: Storm or: Heavy Rain.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Blue Lotus Spells during the Season: Autumn, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Below zero
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 6
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: The Lotus Eater changes water into ice!
Effect: Cast at a Terrain Feature. The Terrain Feature is changed to ice and the whole Terrain piece is classed as Difficult Terrain. Place a Magical Token next to the Terrain piece to mark the effect of the Spell. The effect lasts until the end of the game. Any model within the Terrain Footprint have to make a test against Frost Base Attack.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Blizzard
rules.description:
Range: LOS
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: The Lotus Eater calls forth the fury of nature to throw his enemies into the midst of an icy blizzard.
Effect: Cast at an enemy Unit within LOS. A normal Spell Saving Roll is allowed. If successfully cast the target Unit cannot make an Advanced Move this turn. Additionally, if the Spell has been cast successfully, you may spend 1 CP to change the Weather Card to: Thunder-snow.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Freeze
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 5
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: Under the Lotus Eaters influence, coldness envelops nearby enemies, hampering their every action.
Effect: Cast at an enemy model. A normal Spell saving roll is allowed. If the test is failed, the target model becomes Frozen. Place a Frozen token next to it. The effect of the Spell lasts until the End Phase of this turn.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Ice Wall
rules.description:
Range: LOS
Level: 7
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: The Lotus Eater erects ice barriers on the battlefield to either cover the flanks of his fellow soldiers, or entrap his enemies.
Effect: When this Spell is successfully cast, the Spellcaster conjures an Icewall anywhere within their LOS. The Icewall must be placed in a legal way, as any another miniature would be deployed on the Game Board, and cannot be placed on top of another models base. Treat the Icewall as Impassable Terrain, blocking LOS with a footprint of 5” x 1” and a height of 4”. The Icewall will remain in place until the end of the game. A Spellcaster can conjure a maximum number of Icewalls equal to their Wizardry Level. The Icewall is an Obstacle, fully blocks LOS, has Armour 20 and 3 Structure Points with the Skill: Ice Warrior.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Ice Weapon
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 6
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: The Lotus Eater possesses the ability to imbue the mundane weapons of his fellow warriors with magical properties.
Effect: Cast at a friendly Warband. Every Close Combat Weapon in possession of the targeted Warband gains the Skill: Frost Based Attacks, until the end of the turn.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Snowstorm
rules.description:
Range: LOS
Level: 7
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 5
Description: The Lotus Eater calls forth a fully fledged snowstorm to cover the battlefield, forcing their enemies to seek shelter.
Effect: Cast at a target Unit within LOS. Normal Spell Saving Rolls are allowed. If successfully cast, the targeted Unit cannot make Advanced Moves or Shooting Attacks this turn. Also, they cannot be the target of non-template shooting attacks until the End Phase of the Turn.
Additionally, if the Spell has been cast successfully, you may spend 1 CP to change the Weather Card to: Snowstorm.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Summon Ice Elemental
rules.description:
Range: Summon
Level: 9 3rd Circle
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 10
Description: The Lotus Eater calls forth the fury of nature to create a vessel for elemental demon
Effect: Summon an Ice Elemental up to 4” from the caster. Ice Elemental acts as separate Unit. You can still Activate an Ice Elemental in a Game Turn it has been summoned.

The Level of each Spell casting attempt using Silver Lotus Spells during the Season: Winter, is reduced by 1.
